notes: The BA ICBS page and the DAAD page state no day+month+year application deadline for this programme, and the deadline '15 July' is a general one: 01.04.2026 'Öffnung des uni-assist Bewerbungsportals für Bewerbungen mit internationalen Qualifikationen' and '15.07.2026 Bewerbungsschluss für grundständige Studiengänge über uni-assist' on https://www.uni-passau.de/termine-fristen. The September 2026 deadlines on https://www.uni-passau.de/termine-fristen concern 'Studium in Passau für US-Studierende' (https://www.uni-passau.de/studieninfos-usa). The VPD/uni-assist route for international applicants at this university could not be quoted.

note.fr: Si vous fournissez un certificat B2 au moment de la candidature, vous pouvez postuler, mais vous devrez présenter un certificat C1 avant l'inscription.
note.en: With a B2 certificate at the time of application you may apply, but you will have to provide a C1 certificate by the time you enrol.

evidence.quote: If you can provide recognised certificates for German language skills at level B2 CEFR at the time of application, you may apply for this degree programme.
